summary: Coup is a fast, tense bluffing game where you claim character powers you may not actually have, daring opponents to challenge you or fold to your threat. Games are short and vicious, often decided by a single successful bluff or a lucky challenge near the end.
praised: Bluffing and reading opponents is genuinely fun
criticised: Player elimination means early-out players wait around
Luck of the draw (which characters you get) can swing outcomes
Can devolve into pure aggression/kingmaking in larger groups
Depth is fairly shallow after many plays

interaction.kind: bluffing, accusing, and open conflict via coin theft and assassination

scoring.why: The last player left with any influence (face-down cards) wins, decided entirely by bluffing, challenges, and eliminating opponents' cards
